authority_gained: Implement and publish Platform bounded-outcome governance, then continue to the separately validated FFFA implementation without continuation-only Owner prompts.
Make routine design and repair decisions inside the approved architecture and outcome.
authority_not_gained: No merge, release, production, deployment, customer-data access, destructive action, or live work.
No authority to overwrite or discard preserved PLAT-15.1A work.

decision_references.approved_effect: Approve the Cross-Repository Bounded-Outcome Governance Consolidation implementation and protected publication sequence.

completion.condition: Platform governance validations pass, publication is complete, live remote equality is proved, and the FFFA handoff state is durable.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly one governance model is active for new Platform work.
A fresh task recovers authority, current state, and next action without task history.
Routine repairs and included publication steps require no continuation prompt.
One isolated writer lane is permitted only with a dedicated worktree and non-overlapping owned roots.
All focused and repository governance validations pass without tracked volatile report changes.
Protected Platform publication and live remote equality are proved.
outcome.organizational_or_customer_value: Increase engineering throughput and reduce Owner micro-decisions while preserving architecture, safety, and durable continuity.
outcome.plain_language_result: Replace competing phase-by-phase governance with one repository-driven bounded outcome for new work.

tier_3_checkpoints.subject: Validated Platform governance commit published to the protected default branch and proved equal to the live remote.

acceptance_evidence: Commit, push, fetch, and live remote equality
